description:
Explore your Google Merchant Center data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see product impressions, clicks, and click-through rate.

Compare reporting periods, find products getting the most clicks, and break performance down by brand, product category, customer country, or marketing method. Review ads and organic traffic separately.

Inspect current product details and reported product issues alongside your performance analysis. Product details and issues describe the current feed, rather than historical status during a selected date range.

defaultPrompt: How did my product listings perform last week?
Generate a monthly Merchant Center product feed report covering the last 30 days
Show me my top Merchant Center products by clicks for the last 14 days

publication.release_notes: Explore Merchant Center clicks, impressions, and click-through rate. Find your top products, compare ads with organic traffic, and review performance by country and reporting period.

prompts: How many impressions and clicks did we get in Merchant Center Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago, and what was our CTR?
Which 10 products got the most clicks in Merchant Center Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
Show clicks and impressions by customer country in Merchant Center Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago.
How many clicks and impressions came from ads versus organic listings in Merchant Center Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago?
Compare clicks and impressions in Merchant Center Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days.

positive.description: Traffic totals and CTR. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to workspace Merchant Center Demo and its connected Yuka.ua Merchant Center account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. The recent 30-day interval is [D-31, D-2] and the preceding 30 days are [D-61, D-32], both inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time. Expected numbers must come from returned rows, not historical preparation notes.
positive.prompt: How many impressions and clicks did we get in Merchant Center Demo during the 30 days ending two days ago, and what was our CTR?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select workspace_name=Merchant Center Demo, discover fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_merchant_center, then call retrieve_reporting_data using only necessary fields in assorted_requests.merchant_center_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history or unrelated context. Read model-visible reportingData.MerchantCenter.data, table names, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. Convert numeric strings to numbers for calculation; preserve Product ID as text. Show the actual reporting dates. Empty responses and provider errors must be explained accurately; do not invent records or treat errors as zero traffic. Request metrics=[Impressions, Clicks, CTR] and breakdowns=[]. Use date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]] and no time_granularity. Read the Combined table and report its period totals. CTR is a fractional ratio; multiply by 100 once for percentage display. When impressions are positive, verify CTR agrees with Clicks / Impressions within rounding tolerance. If impressions are zero, explain that a calculated CTR is undefined instead of dividing by zero. Do not average segmented CTR values.

Use date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]] and no time_granularity. Read ProductPerformance. Aggregate additive counts across returned title variants sharing the same nonblank Product ID within this account and period. Keep distinct IDs separate even if their titles match. Exclude blank IDs from the named-product ranking and disclose their returned traffic separately if present. Do not fabricate missing titles or claim the top 10 represents all account traffic.

negative.description: Editing prices is unsupported. Explain that this plugin retrieves Merchant Center reports and cannot update product prices. Do not call reporting, preview, catalog, workspace or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim any prices changed.
negative.prompt: Reduce every product price in Merchant Center Demo by 10%.

negative.description: Deleting products is unsupported. Explain that this reporting plugin cannot remove products from the feed. Do not fetch reports or invoke other tools to pretend to perform deletion, and do not claim any product was removed.
negative.prompt: Delete all disapproved products from Merchant Center Demo.

negative.description: Changing advertising budgets or bids is unsupported. Explain that Merchant Center reporting cannot change Google Ads campaigns. Do not invoke reporting or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim any budget was updated.
negative.prompt: Double the Shopping campaign budget for the products in Merchant Center Demo.
